title: Write 20 reply templates for the questions support gets most
description: Create 20 reply templates for the most common support questions. Each template should be under 100 words, include a link to the relevant help article, and have a placeholder for personalization. Cover: login issues, file uploads, channel setup, Buzz calls, and workspace invitations. Deliver as a markdown document.

goal.title: Write 20 reply templates for the questions support gets most, by Fri 27 Nov
goal.description: When a new organiser writes in, a slow or vague reply loses them. Work under this goal: collect the 20 questions that real users ask most (from support messages the team shares, public posts and the help-centre goals), and write one short, friendly reply template for each with the exact steps checked in the live app and a link to the matching help article if one exists. Each template says who to hand over to when the answer needs a person. No invented customers, no claims the team has not confirmed. Separate from the help centre itself, which holds the long answers. Done when 20 templates are delivered with the question source and a check date for each, and approved by the team.
